name: Abris Capital Partners
decision_note: Warsaw-based mid-market private equity (control investments, EUR 30-75m equity tickets, focus Poland and Romania) with offices in Warsaw, Bucharest and Nicosia but none in Czechia - PE (S1) and outside the pilot country (S2).

analyst_notes: Quick S1 dossier. Strategy page states EU-11 focus on Poland and Romania, control investments in mature businesses, sectors healthcare, circular economy, digital and technology, e-commerce and modern logistics, specialist manufacturing (mapped to the closed sector list). Latest dated activity found: add-on acquisition by portfolio company Dental Holding (2026-01-20) and the sale of Czech-linked AURES Holdings / AAA Auto (signed 2025-12-12). Capital not researched for this quick dossier; the CVCA profile (class D, self-reported, 2020) lists EUR 502m Abris Fund III and EUR 450m Fund II. Polish management entity not looked up. [revision 2026-10-25 after review: S2 added alongside S1: focus 'EU-11 with a focus on Poland and Romania' (e6); the contact page lists offices in Warsaw (e7), Bucharest and Nicosia only - no Czech office, so the revised scope rule is not met even though AURES / AAA Auto was a Czech-linked portfolio company. Capital filled from the public fund sizes instead of not_disclosed: the CVCA member profile (self-reported, published 2020-01-26) lists Abris Fund III EUR 502m and Fund II EUR 450m (e5); the newest listed fund, Fund III (EUR 502m), is recorded as latest_fund_size, as_of the profile date. Caveat: the profile does not state the close status (both funds listed with event other, so V5 will flag it) and no newer fund size was found on the abris-capital.com pages checked (home, strategy, contact).]
